content: Patients with type 2 diabetes may require a combination of basal insulin and prandial (mealtime) insulin doses to effectively manage their blood glucose levels and achieve their glycemic targets. The typical starting dose for insulin therapy is 5 units per kilogram of body weight per day. Adjustments to the insulin regimen should be tailored to the individual patient’s needs, taking into account their target fasting blood glucose levels. Additionally, basal insulin therapy can be combined with other glucose-lowering medications to optimize glycemic control.
